thread:
maria: FYI customer 'AcmeCorp' reports 502s when using our function adapter for their price lookup flow. Started around 11:07 UTC.
lee: Can you paste the failing request payload and any stack trace?
maria: here's the body they sent (redacted):
```json
{
  "sku": "T-900",
  "zip": "94103",
  "currency": "USD"
}
```
They say it used to work yesterday.
ravi: quick thought — adapter schema expects `zip` as an integer (US ZIP). The string could be tripping our schema validator in the tool call layer.
deploy-bot: [logs] 2026-03-17T11:07:21Z adapter.price_fetch SchemaValidationError: expected integer for args.zip, got string
james: CI alert: our tool-calling regression suite started failing on the golden prompt after the selector change — job https://ci.redwood/4221 shows identical assertion: `assert isinstance(args['zip'], int)` failed in 3/5 runs.
maria: customer also mentioned higher latency spikes just before the 502s, not sure if related.
ana: (typo) ana: I see a routing/selector toggle rolled out yesterday that changes model->tool affinity when confidence is low. If a different model variant sends slightly different arg types, our strict validator will reject.
lee: repro steps from customer: 1) call chat endpoint with tool call to adapter.price_fetch 2) include zip as string 3) sometimes returns 400, sometimes 502. Intermittent.
ravi: reproduction locally: run the golden prompt from tests but force the model variant used in prod selector. I can repro the validation failure consistently when model emits quotes around numeric fields.
james: test output snippet:
```py
# failing assertion in ci
assert isinstance(response['tool_args']['zip'], int)
> AssertionError: got '94103' (str)
```

ana: action plan: short-term, add a tolerant coercion in adapter: try cast int(args.get('zip')) with safe fallback + log a warning. Long-term, update our schema tests and add model-output canonicalization step in the toolcall harness.
maria: I'll escalate to the account team and notify Acme we're investigating. Assigned to @ravi for the hotfix and @james for CI test updates.
ravi: I'll push a small adapter patch to coerce numeric-like strings -> int and add a unit test. Will also drop a canary behind feature flag.
james: I'll update the regression harness to include a golden-case where numeric fields are strings, and mark CI job 4221 as flaky until fixed.
lee: Also recommend adding an eval that runs the model selector + toolcall combo nightly to catch selector-induced shape drift.
ana: FYI I'll add an alert when SchemaValidationError rate > 0.5% over 5m for adapters to catch regressions faster.
maria: thanks all — please post PR links and CI green in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
